extraction.name: MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark
extraction.description: The Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) spans 8 embedding tasks covering a total of 58 datasets and 112 languages. It aims to provide clarity on how models perform on a variety of embedding tasks and serves as the gateway to finding universal text embeddings applicable to a variety of tasks.
extraction.creator: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MTEB aggregates datasets from various sources including public APIs (arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv), existing benchmarks (SemEval, BEIR, SuperGLUE), and community contributions. Datasets are sourced from platforms like Kaggle, Amazon, Reddit, StackExchange, and academic papers.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Web Scraping, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Datasets include text from arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv, Amazon reviews, Reddit posts, StackExchange posts, 20 Newsgroups, Twitter, Civil Comments, and various academic benchmarks like SemEval and BEIR.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Datasets are grouped into three categories based on text length: Sentence to sentence (S2S), Paragraph to paragraph (P2P), and Sentence to paragraph (S2P). For clustering tasks, splits are created based on main and secondary categories. For multilingual tasks, specific language pairs are selected.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For S2S clustering, input text is the title. For P2P, it is the concatenation of title and abstract. For S2P, queries are single sentences and documents are paragraphs. Labels are generated using human-provided categories for arXiv/bioRxiv/medRxiv. Data is uploaded to Hugging Face Hub.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Labels are derived from existing annotations in source datasets (e.g., human ratings for STS, intent labels for classification, toxicity annotations for Civil Comments, human summaries for SummEval). For custom MTEB datasets like ArxivClustering, labels are generated using categories given to papers by humans.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Varies by task (e.g., continuous scores for STS, binary/multi-class labels for classification, relevance scores for summarization)
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: MTEB is open-source with a public leaderboard. New datasets and tasks can be contributed via pull requests. Results are versioned at dataset and software levels.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset includes user-generated content such as Amazon reviews, Reddit posts, StackExchange posts, and Civil Comments, which may contain personal information.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: MTEB aims to provide reliable embedding performance estimates to ease decision-making for future research or industry applications. It highlights that no single model dominates all tasks, suggesting the field has not converged on a universal method.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The benchmark has task imbalance, with summarization having only one dataset while retrieval, classification, and clustering have many. Retrieval and clustering datasets are English-only. There is potential data contamination as MTEB does not control for overlap with model training datasets.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: 1. Long document datasets are missing. 2. Task imbalance exists. 3. Multilinguality is limited to classification, STS, and bitext mining; retrieval and clustering are English-only. 4. No code datasets are included. 5. Text embeddings are focused solely on natural language applications.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning of text embedding models. Evaluation of embedding performance across diverse tasks including bitext mining, classification, clustering, pair classification, reranking, retrieval, STS, and summarization.
